import math

print(f"Mean Canadian Dollars: {y_mean}")

x_devs = [x - x_mean for x in belgian_francs]
y_devs = [y - y_mean for y in canadian_dollars]

print(f"\nBelgian Franc deviations: {x_devs}")
print(f"Canadian Dollar deviations: {y_devs}")

# Calculate products of deviations
products = [x_devs[i] * y_devs[i] for i in range(len(x_devs))]
print(f"\nProducts: {products}")

# Sum of products
sum_products = sum(products)

# Sum of squared deviations
sum_x_squared = sum(x**2 for x in x_devs)
sum_y_squared = sum(y**2 for y in y_devs)

print(f"Sum of squared Y deviations: {sum_y_squared}")

r = sum_products / math.sqrt(sum_x_squared * sum_y_squared)
